marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF961B Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a brushless motor and offers 1200 ft-lb of fastening torque and 1750 ft-lb of breakaway torque. This 20V tool has a 1/2 in square drive and a 4-mode push button switch that easily changes speeds and LED brightness. With a glass-filled nylon housing and hog ring anvil for quick socket changes, this impact wrench is designed for heavy-duty applications.
